shouldFix.title: The G10 provenance role denies the four platform-directory copies that v12 actually authors
shouldFix.claimUnderReview: The role says that g21-fixture-corpus.v12 'does not copy those platforms into fixture directories in this payload authoring.'
primaryEvidence: The complete authoredCatalog declares payloadCount 1, platformCount 4, copyCount 4 and lists one path under each of macos-arm64, macos-x86_64, linux-x86_64 and linux-arm64. Those four catalog paths exactly equal the four regular files on disk, and every file is mode 0444 with digest 67abdd721024f0ff4e0b3f4c2fc13bc5bad42d0b7851d456d88d203d15aaa450.

The operative top-level surfaces all say the opposite of the role: registerRowNote and purpose say v12 authors per-D-002-platform copies; authorityClaim says the four quoted D-002 tokens are copied onto; whatIsAuthored says four platform-indexed copies; summary reports platformCopiesAuthored true and authoredFiles 4.

The other current-standing lineage roles are consistent with the catalog: basedOn.d293.role says per-D-002-platform copies exercise the delegation, basedOn.leftoverJoinV13.role says v12 authors those copies, and basedOn.d301.role says v12 copies the recorded payload onto the quoted G10 occupancy platforms.

The v11-to-v12 diff shows that basedOn.g10OccupancyV2.role retained v11's no-copy sentence and changed only its speaker from v11 to v12, even though v12 changed the corpus from flat payload authoring to the v8-shaped four-platform continuation copy authoring.
shouldFix.impact: The pinned provenance metadata simultaneously says the platform copies exist and do not exist. A later leftover remasurement or lineage reader could cite this current-standing role as evidence that the per-platform copy authoring remains undone, contradicting the disk-backed catalog and corrupting authoring-remainder accounting. The contradiction also makes the G10 platform-source recital dishonest at the exact point where the source's role in this successor is explained.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The false no-copy statement is confined to one explanatory basedOn role string. The fixture bytes, catalog paths, digests, platform ordering, counts, summary flags, expected behavior, remainder inventory, closure array and protected-status boundaries are all correct, and OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains open. This is therefore a material current-standing consistency defect rather than corrupt fixture authoring or a false closure measurement.
shouldFix.requiredRemedy: In a frozen successor, rewrite basedOn.g10OccupancyV2.role to say that the four platform tokens are quoted from G10 and are used for the four v12-shaped platform directories, while preserving that the corpus does not occupy G10 and does not invent the D-002 platform list. Preserve this frozen subject, v11 and every fixture unchanged.
